d:
A duo consisting of a lithe, feline-like predator and a hulking, brutish beast. The Dreamrunner has sleek midnight black fur and a long, whip-like tail, while the Drekavac has thick, charcoal grey hide and a heavy, club-shaped tail. Both possess glowing amber eyes and three sharp claws per limb.
BODY COLOR: midnight black and charcoal grey
